propositions: review_interrupts metric is published dimensionless and cannot distinguish bound-exceeded from signal-unavailable, preventing CloudWatch alarms from routing to appropriate remediation without host shell access

bound-exceeded (DEPLOY_DEFER_MAX exhausted, reviews in flight) and signal-unavailable (/health probe unreadable, deploys run blind) require opposite remediations but are indistinguishable in the current alarm

split review_interrupts into three separate dimensionless metrics (review_interrupts_bound_exceeded, review_interrupts_signal_unavailable, review_interrupts rolled-up total) by pattern-matching the reason field in AUTODEPLOY_REVIEW_INTERRUPT JSON markers via the existing publish_autodeploy_marker_delta helper

replace the single review_interrupts alarm with two reason-scoped alarms (rebar-autodeploy-review-interrupts-bound-exceeded and rebar-autodeploy-review-interrupts-signal-unavailable), each carrying only its own remediation in the description, keeping 900s/1-datapoint cadence and leaving the rolled-up metric unalarmed
signal-unavailable alarm must remain promptly alarming (evaluation_periods=1, datapoints_to_alarm=1) because it indicates deploys are running blind and requires urgent remediation
terraform apply is required to activate the new alarms on the CloudWatch account; until applied, the new metrics publish but old single alarm remains active
